note: Set B is better because it avoids a significant misbound error found in Set A regarding Beam B1. Set A claims Beam B1 has a 3-inch diameter opening, but the drawing shows Beam B1 has rectangular openings (2"-6"-2"), while the 3-inch diameter applies to Beams E6, A4, and C1. Both sets incorrectly claim a 2-inch top edge distance for Beam E6, which is not dimensioned on that specific detail. Both sets also suffer from duplicates and vague terminology (using 'width' for vertical height).
remarks: Both sets hallucinate the 2" vertical offset for Beam E6 (Detail E6 only shows a 3" diameter hole without vertical offsets). Set A additionally misattributes the 3" diameter to Beam B1. Both sets inconsistently label the 6" vertical opening dimension as 'width' in some claims and 'height' in others, and both include duplicate claims for beam length (5'-0" and 5 ft).
